scripts.build: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:rust && pnpm run build:browser && pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:standalone && pnpm run build:scenarios && pnpm run build:issue-thread
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:typescript && pnpm run typecheck:rust && pnpm run typecheck:browser
scripts.test: pnpm run build:runner-binaries && pnpm run test:typescript && pnpm run test:rust && node --test scripts/check-forbidden-imports.test.mjs scripts/check-numbered-milestones.test.mjs scripts/check-tracked-imports.test.mjs scripts/record-codex-evidence.test.mjs scripts/validate-doc-links.test.mjs test/capability-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:runner-binaries && pnpm run build:browser && playwright test --config devtools/browser/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:scenarios: vitest run src/scenarios src/live src/semantic-tools/semantic-tools.test.ts src/mock-core/capability-mock-control-plane-adapter.test.ts src/issue-thread devtools/issue-thread/src examples/scenario-explorer
scripts.test:browser:sdk: pnpm run build:typescript && playwright test --config examples/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:browser:scenarios: playwright test --config examples/playwright.scenarios.config.ts && pnpm run test:browser:issue-thread
scripts.test:browser:issue-thread: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:issue-thread && playwright test --config devtools/issue-thread/playwright.config.ts
scripts.record:sdk:codex: pnpm run build:typescript && playwright test --config examples/playwright.real.config.ts
scripts.report:capability-live-evals: pnpm run build:typescript && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node scripts/run-capability-live-eval-matrix.mjs
scripts.check:conformance-parity: vitest run src/tracer/conformance-runner.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core runs_the_mock_core_path_with_stable_output && node -e "process.stdout.write('Rust and TypeScript Conformance tracer output matches the shared golden fixture.\n')"
scripts.check:replay-parity: vitest run src/reducer/session-reducer.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core replay_fixture_parity && node -e "process.stdout.write('Rust and TypeScript Replay reducer summaries match the shared golden fixtures.\n')"
scripts.trace:conformance:rust: pnpm run build:rust && cargo run --quiet --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin conformance-tracer
scripts.trace:local-runner: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:runner-binaries && node dist/cli/local-runner.js
scripts.trace:durable-recovery: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:runner-binaries && node dist/cli/durable-recovery.js
scripts.trace:live-runner: pnpm run build:typescript && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node dist/cli/live-runner.js
scripts.record:capability:ui: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:issue-thread && node scripts/record-capability-ui-evidence.mjs
scripts.check:capability:ui: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:issue-thread && node scripts/record-capability-ui-evidence.mjs --check
scripts.smoke:capability:ui: pnpm run build:typescript && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node scripts/capability-issue-thread-smoke.mjs
scripts.smoke:capability:cleanroom: pnpm run build:typescript && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node scripts/capability-clean-room-smoke.mjs
scripts.record:capability:ui:live: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:issue-thread && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node scripts/record-capability-ui-live-evidence.mjs
scripts.record:capability:cleanroom: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:issue-thread && cargo build --manifest-path runner/Cargo.toml --locked -p paperclip-runner-core --bin paperclip-runnerd && node scripts/record-capability-clean-room-evidence.mjs
scripts.record:durable-recovery: pnpm run build:typescript && pnpm run build:runner-binaries && node scripts/record-durable-recovery-evidence.mjs

scripts.verify: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:replay-goldens && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:sdk && pnpm run test:scenarios && pnpm run check:browser-tokens && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run test:browser:sdk && pnpm run test:browser:scenarios && pnpm run check:forbidden-imports && pnpm run check:tracked-imports && pnpm run check:numbered-milestones && pnpm run check:package-boundaries && pnpm run check:clean-consumers && pnpm run docs:validate && pnpm run check:conformance-parity && pnpm run check:replay-parity && pnpm run trace:conformance && pnpm run replay:fixture && pnpm run trace:local-runner -- --quiet && pnpm run trace:durable-recovery
